The simulation results show that the four kinds of protection strategies are effective, and found that the protection strategy considering the degree of interdependent nodes is more effective than considering unilateral node degree, and compared to consider addition of the interdependent nodes degree, the protection strategy considering product of the dependent nodes degree is much better.

articleTitle: Research on extension control of brushless DC motor of the quad-rotor
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Due to the existence of nonlinear, multi-variable coupled of internal mismatch and wind of external disturbances, the Extension control is designed to fulfill the auto-tuning of control parameters for pitch, roll and yaw angle. Building Matlab simulation model to verify the control effect of the Extension controller, and programming GUI monitoring interface on three-dimensional trace and attitude angle of quadrotor on computer. Simulink simulation results show that: The Extension controller can effectively suppress the overshoot of the system and improve the response speed.

articleTitle: Overview of deep learning
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning has achieved great success in many fields, such as computer vision and natural language processing. Compared to traditional machine learning methods, deep learning has a strong learning ability and can make better use of datasets for feature extraction. Because of its practicability, deep learning becomes more and more popular for many researchers to do research works. In this paper, we mainly introduce some advanced neural networks of deep learning and their applications. Besides, we also discuss the limitations and prospects of deep learning.

articleTitle: Move prediction in Gomoku using deep learning
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The Gomoku board game is a longstanding challenge for artificial intelligence research. With the development of deep learning, move prediction can help to promote the intelligence of board game agents as proven in AlphaGo. Following this idea, we train deep convolutional neural networks by supervised learning to predict the moves made by expert Gomoku players from RenjuNet dataset. We put forward a number of deep neural networks with different architectures and different hyperparameters to solve this problem. With only the board state as the input, the proposed deep convolutional neural networks are able to recognize some special features of Gomoku and select the most likely next move. The final neural network achieves the accuracy of move prediction of about 42% on the RenjuNet dataset, which reaches the level of expert Gomoku players. In addition, it is promising to generate strong Gomoku agents of human-level with the move prediction as a guide.

articleTitle: Trajectory tracking control of a quadrotor UAV under external disturbances based on linear ADRC
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, the trajectory tracking control of a quadrotor UAV under external disturbances is considered. Hierarchical inner-outer loop control scheme is adopted which consists of two parts: the inner loop for attitude control which implements linear active disturbance rejection control strategy and the outer loop for position control which applies sliding mode control method. The stability prove of the closed loop system is given in the paper. Setting desired trajectory, the quadrotor can track it accurately. Simulation results show the good performance of the proposed control scheme under different disturbance conditions.

articleTitle: Adaptive positioning and swing suppression control of underactuated cranes exhibiting double-pendulum dynamics: Theory and experimentation
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel nonlinear control approach for underactuated crane systems with double-pendulum dynamics, which can achieve both rapid swing suppression and efficient cart positioning control. The controller has a simple structure which is easy for implementation, and it can increase the transient performance by introducing some coupling terms. Moreover, it shows satisfactory robustness w.r.t. parametric uncertainties. We provide rigorous Lyapunov-based stability analysis for the closed-loop system. To our knowledge, this paper yields the first closed-loop control scheme, without linearizing or approximating the dynamics, for crane systems with double-pendulum effects and uncertain/unknown parameters. At last, both numerical simulation and hardware experimental results are included to validate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Position estimation and control for quadrotor using optical flow and GPS sensors
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This study presented a position estimation and control method for quadrotor using optical flow and GPS sensors. Firstly, an optical flow based location algorithm is shown that calculates relative position from continues images. Considering the drift problem of optical flow, an improved Kalman filter based position estimation method is presented to enhance performance of location system. Then a PD based controller is developed for quadrotor which equips with a robust compensation to improve system stability. The accuracy of this position estimation system is verified by physical experiments. At last, a quadrotor experiment with position estimation and control method in this paper is carried out, which shows that our method enjoys high performance and is practical.

articleTitle: Singularity-free robust trajectory tracking control for quadrotors via disturbance observer
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper presents a disturbance observer based controller for a quadrotor subjects to external disturbances and unmodeled dynamics. The novel control strategy is based on the hierarchial inner-outer loop structure. During the position loop controller designed, the controller is designed with an auxiliary dynamic system to achieve the position tracking, the appropriate parameters selections criteria can warrant the command attitude derivation from the position controller without singularity. During the attitude loop controller designed, unit-quaternion is used to describe attitude kinematics. In addition, a second order disturbance observer is employed to estimate and compensate the modeling uncertainties. Simulation results are given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the presented control algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-bound-dependent fault-tolerant control for flexible spacecraft under partial loss of actuator effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of fault-tolerant control (FTC) for flexible spacecraft with partial loss of actuator effectiveness and time-varying input delay. An adaptive fault-tolerant controller is designed by using the online estimation, in which an addition control term is added into the normal control law. This compensation method can reduce the fault effect and don't need the isolation mechanism and fault detection. Compared with some existing results, the designed controller is depended on time delay bound. Thus, it can not only be tolerate to the partial loss of actuator effectiveness, but also be sensitive to time delay. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed FTC scheme is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Fuzzy satisfying based differential evolution with flexible interval selection for solving dynamic economic dispatch with wind uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Since dynamic economic dispatch with wind power uncertainty plays an important role in power system operation, this paper proposes a fuzzy satisfying method based differential evolution with flexible interval selection mechanism. Sequential quadratic programming is embedded into differential evolution to provide optimal search direction for mutation operator. Fuzzy satisfying method with flexible interval method improves the selection mechanism with reference memberships, which decreases the conservation for optimization in uncertainty domain of wind power generation. Moreover, a constraint-handling method is proposed to tackle with the system load balance while considering transmission loss. Ultimately, the proposed algorithm with constraint handling method is verified on the thermal-wind power system, and the obtained results prove the efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Regional economic growth forecasting based on partial least square, support vector machine and prosperity index method
publicationTitle: 2016 31st Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Electric industry is now playing a more and more important role in national economic market. As a consequence, economic status demonstrates quite close connection and great correlation with electrical industry. Along with the development of information technology and requirement of accurate resource deployment, economic trend forecasting has become a focus of interdisciplinary studies. Traditionally, GPD time series methodologies are attempted to analyze future economic status, which is proven to be inaccurate and unreliable. In this paper, we aim to tackle this problem from the perspective of electric industry, and thus propose a relatively more effective and reliable solution. In order to achieve this goal, various statistical and data mining methods are adopted in our algorithm including PLS, ARIMA and SVM. On the basis of this algorithm, a novel electric power prosperity index is proposed to evaluate the regional economic performance by combining electric operation dimensions and other auxiliary economic variables. Eventually, a case study on the data of electric industry in southern China has been conducted. The results illustrate the prediction feasibility of electric power prosperity index and the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The proposed scheme can provide firm support to future investment and construction for electric power enterprises.
